headline: DATA QUALITY CORRECTION of event_id=154: MPR retained at 12.00% on 2014-01-21, not 30.00%
notes: Stage 10E remediation (2026-08-08). event_id=154 recorded outcome_numeric=30.00 under headline 'MPC: MPR retained at 30.00%' -- this is a DATA QUALITY CORRECTION of that row, NOT an economic restatement (CBN never restated this decision; no new capture occurred). Evidence: (1) every other MPC meeting Nov2013-Sep2014 held MPR at 12.00% (event_id 83-92), 30.00% is the only outlier in the series; (2) the canonical source batch data/events_batches/cbn_mpc/events/mpc_decisions_2026-07-16.csv -- cited as the provenance for both event_id 154 and 156 -- contains only ONE row for 2014-01-21, outcome_numeric=12.00, no 30.00 row exists in that file; (3) scripts/scrape_cbn_mpc.py's current parser isolates the <li> clause containing 'Monetary Policy Rate'/'MPR' specifically to avoid picking up corridor/Liquidity-Ratio percentages, and runs a hold-vs-previous-level consistency check that would flag a 30.00 hold against a 12.00 prior -- the 30.00 row could not have been produced by this script and does not exist in any checked-in script/CSV/JSON in this repo; (4) external corroboration (web search against CBN's own published record) confirms the 20-21 Jan 2014 MPC meeting retained MPR at 12% (+/-200bps corridor) while separately maintaining the Liquidity Ratio at 30% and raising public-sector CRR 50%->75% -- the 30.00% figure in event_id=154 is real but belongs to the Liquidity Ratio, mislabeled as the MPR. event_id=156 (outcome_numeric=12.00, identical headline text to the canonical CSV) is the authoritative original record; this correction shares its event_uid so PIT reads (ngxrot.db.events_asof) resolve the uid group to the corrected record. event_id=154 is preserved unmodified, never deleted or overwritten -- see docs/STAGE10E_EVENT_IDENTITY_AND_NEWS_INGESTION_INTEGRITY_2026-08-08.md for the full investigation and remediation record.
